scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix mfe-cadastro && npm install --prefix mfe-operacoes
scripts.build:remotes: npm run build --prefix mfe-cadastro && npm run build --prefix mfe-operacoes
scripts.build: npm run build:remotes && npm run build --prefix client
